description: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved by different model configurations across five datasets. The horizontal axis displays the categories, representing the datasets SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL, arranged in a non-alphabetical order without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis is a linear value axis labeled "F1 Score (%)", with a range from 80 to 100 and numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 10. Each dataset category contains a cluster of three adjacent bars. According to the legend at the top, the left-most light green bar represents "MADLLM", and the right-most light orange bar represents "MADLLM w/o skip embedding". The middle light purple bar corresponds to a legend entry where the text is visually obscured by a gray rectangle. All bars feature a thin black outline. Visually, the light green "MADLLM" bars consistently display the greatest height within each group. The tallest bar overall is the light green bar in the PSM category, reaching an approximate value of 97%. The shortest bar in the chart is the light purple bar in the SWaT category, at approximately 86%. The light orange bars range from roughly 86.5% in the SWaT category to 92.5% in the PSM category. The categories are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending order based on bar height, and no individual bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard coloring and outlines.
